verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every finding is ranked by severity and that Qodo avoids overwhelming users with low-signal feedback. Noise is controlled through a Relevance score learned from how the team handled past PRs, Minimal/Standard/Comprehensive presets, per-finding-type toggles, and the ability to dismiss findings. missing for 10: any evidence of comment deduplication, independent or hands-on corroboration of a low false-positive rate.
